quotes: Bell-mère was a former Marine officer, the owner of a mikan farm in Cocoyasi Village, and the adoptive mother of Nami and Nojiko.

She cared about her daughters deeply, she would give them as much as she could afford, often at her own expense; when times were harsh, she ate only the fruit she grew in her grove, thus saving enough money to keep feeding her daughters on suitable meals, and would lie about being on a "diet" to hide it.
Bell-mère lived with the girls on her mikan grove in Cocoyasi Village.
Bell-mère's body was buried on a nearby cliff outside of the village, with a pair of sticks tied in a cross to act as her grave marker.
After Bell-mère's death, Nami was forced to join Arlong's crew for her cartography skills, which they planned to use to create sea charts to help them conquer the East Blue.
description: Bell-mère[6] was a former Marine officer, the owner of a mikan farm in Cocoyasi Village, and the adoptive mother of Nami and Nojiko.[1] She raised the two girls in her hometown for approximately nine years until she was murdered by Arlong.
